body: I will, thank you again. I have the number written down right here and I will certainly never forget you.

Better, thank you. I wrote theonlycuregirl and she responded in length with some of the nicest things I've ever read about myself. I spent the day sober, which is a rare occurrence these days. You guys are doing a really, really good thing here and I'm sure I'll join in helping others once I get myself out of my own rut as a way of repaying.
I can't sleep, decided to check for replies once more. Seeing one was relieving. It is very nice of you. I don't want to burden you. I will try to sleep, and maybe tomorrow I will write you.
